items.headline: Stocks Surge as Inflation Data Aligns with Expectations; Fed Rate Hike Odds Jump
items.summary: U.S. equities rallied today, breaking a four-day losing streak, fueled by August Consumer Price Index (CPI) data largely matching forecasts and a retreat in oil prices. The positive market sentiment, however, was accompanied by increased expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next week. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Dell Technologies
items.summary: Dell Technologies surged, driven by strong performance in AI-related stocks.

items.headline: Oracle Corp.
items.summary: Oracle's shares were boosted by stronger-than-expected profit and revenue for the latest quarter, with its AI cloud backlog exceeding estimates.

items.headline: August CPI Report In-Line, Core CPI Slightly Hotter
items.summary: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) for August 2026 increased 0.4% on a seasonally adjusted basis and 3.4% year-over-year, aligning with the Dow Jones consensus. Core CPI, excluding food and energy, rose 0.3% for the month, slightly above forecasts, and 2.4% annually, in line with expectations.

items.headline: Fed Rate Hike Expectations Surge Ahead of FOMC Meeting
items.summary: Following the CPI data release, the probability of a 25-basis-point interest rate hike at the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on September 16 surged to 85.6% from 72.4% yesterday, reflecting market anticipation of a more restrictive monetary policy.

items.headline: Technology Sector, Driven by AI, Leads Market Gains
items.summary: The technology sector, particularly AI-related stocks, demonstrated strong leadership in today's market rally. Companies like Dell, Arista Networks, Intel, Alphabet, and Apple posted significant gains, indicating continued investor confidence in artificial intelligence investments.

items.headline: Oil Prices Retreat from Recent Highs
items.summary: Oil prices eased today, with West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures dropping 3% to $99.28 per barrel and Brent crude futures falling 3.1% to $104.32 per barrel, providing some relief to inflation concerns despite remaining elevated for the week.

items.headline: Kroger Reports Q2 Results, Lowers Sales Guidance
items.summary: The Kroger Co. ($KR) reported its second-quarter 2026 results today. While the company reaffirmed its full-year adjusted net earnings per diluted share guidance, it lowered its full-year identical sales guidance excluding fuel, reflecting ongoing challenges.
